# AC-UAT-11 — fresh reviewer verdict

Reviewer: fresh general-purpose subagent, given only `contact-sheet.jpg` (1 s sheet, 1280 px frames, 2 cols) and the case's Then clause.

1 PASS — The second beat's caption reads "Tick it off when done" at 05.00 through 09.00, with no trailing punctuation that I can see. It replaces "Type a task and press Enter" (01.00 to 04.00) and gives way to "Filters show what is left, or done" at 10.00.

2 PASS — The other three beats each show a caption:
- Beat 1: "Type a task and press Enter" (01.00 to 04.00). 00.00 has no caption, probably a fade-in rather than a defect.
- Beat 3: "Filters show what is left, or done" (10.00 to 14.00).
- Beat 4: "Clear done tasks to tidy up" (15.00 to 19.00).

All captions sit below the app card, are legible even downscaled, and never cover the UI. The cursor is visible at every click: input field (01.00 to 05.00), "Buy milk" checkbox (06.00), Active (10.00), Done (12.00), Clear done (15.00 to 16.00) and All (17.00 to 19.00).

3 PASS — No blank, half-loaded or clipped frames. Every frame shows the full app card in a consistent layout. The only data on screen is demo content ("Buy milk", "Call the plumber") and no private data.

Overall: PASS for the video. The stills can't show the approval-step part of the Then clause (the original → proposed display, the change being applied, and no second gate before recording). Check that in the session transcript.
